findings: Initial independent S review FAIL: 201-500 rows could be silently truncated to the 200-row display projection, and redirect omitted the deployment script prefix. Both findings were reproduced before correction.

Final independent S review PASS after corrections: reviewer independently verified 201 valid rows return 400 with previews=0/invoices=0, the 200-row boundary returns 302 with persisted_rows=200, and /pmo/ prefix redirects to /pmo/modules/onboarding/import-submit/. Reviewer reran all 74 scoped tests (5.493s, exit 0) plus 3 boundary reproductions (1.381s, exit 0); no new blocking finding.

deviations: Independent S review initially rejected the implementation: preview_import truncates its display rows to 200 while CSV accepts 500, and the first redirect omitted the deployment script prefix. Added a 201-row rejection with zero preview/business writes and a script-prefix regression; larger files must be split for this save action, while read-only preview behavior is unchanged.

The first full local run failed with 3 failures and 3 errors in DRF security compatibility because the existing virtualenv had djangorestframework 3.16.1 while requirements pin 3.18.2. Installed the locked dependencies with uv; the targeted 13 tests then passed and the final full 1501-test run passed. No test or product scope was changed to bypass the failure.

The default local runtime verify_integrity command failed because core_timesheet.organization_id is missing from that unmigrated user database. It was not migrated or reset in this slice. The passing integrity evidence is explicitly from a separate newly migrated demo database.

Desktop 1440px and mobile 390px isolated SQLite browser runs both completed upload/save, period precheck, atomic commit, committed receipt, invoice reconciliation and operations workbench. The demo reconciliation still reports revenue_invoice_mismatch and tax_qualification_missing; the workbench retains import_preview_persistence_not_implemented and identity issues. These existing source/upstream gaps are not claimed as fixed.

Browser file selection used the real file input with generated demo CSV; no real customer, payroll or credential data entered the source or external service. Temporary Playwright tooling was installed outside the repository and is not a product dependency.
